title: locked keys Mod
description: Control player inputs and create cinematic fixed cameras for immersive gameplay and events. Requires the server plugin to function.
body:
# 🎮 BlockKeys Mod

BlockKeys is a client-side mod designed to give servers full control over player inputs and camera behavior, enabling advanced gameplay mechanics and cinematic experiences.

## ✨ Features
- Block and unblock specific keys (WASD, mouse, etc.)
- Freeze and unfreeze player movement
- Real-time control of player inputs
- Fixed cinematic camera system
- Player can move and rotate independently from the camera
- Supports immersive and controlled gameplay scenarios

## 🎬 Cinematic Camera System
Create cinematic views where:
- The camera stays fixed at a specific position
- The player can still move, jump, and rotate
- The gameplay continues independently of the camera
- The HUD can be hidden for clean visuals

This makes it perfect for:
- Cutscenes
- Events
- Spectator systems
- Custom gamemodes

## ⚙️ How It Works
The mod listens to instructions sent by the server plugin and applies them in real-time on the client, allowing precise control over:
- Movement
- Actions (clicks, sprint, jump, etc.)
- Camera positioning

## 🔌 Requirements
This mod **requires the BlockKeys server plugin** to function properly.

## 🚀 Use Cases
- Minigames
- Competitive events
- Roleplay servers
- Cinematic recordings
- Admin control systems

---

Built for advanced server experiences.
